text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gods, grant me victory in the Arima
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Is what I used to say, but not today.
Today, I'm
going to make it on my own.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This time, I want the gods to sit back
and watch.
I'll be doing all the work. So
my wish instead will
be...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: For... Uh? Uhhhh...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What do I do, Trainer?! I don't have
anything to
ask for!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The diva of divination has run out of
prayers!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nothing is coming to mind. I've already
got good
fortune, and I know exactly
what I want for
myself!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Have I lost my mojo? Could it be my well
of faith
has run dry?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Satisfied? I suppose I do feel somewhat
content...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that solves it! There's no need for
wishes
when you're this happy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hm...
While this is a nice feeling at first,
I say it's a cause of concern. What will
the gods think of me if I show up with
nothing to say?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If I just had even one little thing to ask
for...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're at the shrine, but
Matikanefukukitaru can't
think of
anything to pray for.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No... I can't go out there like this! To
think I can
no longer perform my rites
when it really counts.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nothing can beat this overwhelming
happiness I
feel. So what can I pray for
other than victory...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Everyone's... happiness? Not my own?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I remind her that all the people who
cheered her
on are a big part of why she
has been able to
come so far.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's true. I'm only happy thanks to
everyone's
support. It's about time I
return the favor.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now that my dream has come true, it's
my turn to
make everyone else happy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her expression is of unabashed
dignity—perhaps
the heavens truly do
smile upon her.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Would I make everyone happy if I won
the Arima
Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Then praying might not be what's
needed
here.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You see, praying isn't the only thing you
can do
before the gods.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm still learning the ropes, but today's
the perfect
day to give this a real shot.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hark! O Shiraoki, who resides on this
sanctified
altar, heed my oath!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: To bring joy to everyone who taught me to stand proud, I will win the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I humbly make this vow before all the
gods!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her voice rings out clearly through the
cold
December skies, delivering her
solemn promise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen will soon be upon us.
